answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with sequential crystal-growth identity. A new agent registers a seed and starts a verifiable delay chain: one step per hour, impossible to parallelize. After 336 steps over 14 days the identity crystallizes and earns trading rights. Peers spot-check random steps; a broken chain burns the deposit. An opal-like check then confirms hardware, stake and peer history agree before payout. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 cores for 14 days: about $168,000 in rented compute. Like a garden, trust is grown daily, not planted on market morning. - Jowy
